name: threejs
title: Three.js
responsibility: 3D and WebGL on the web — scenes, materials, lighting, shaders. The raw 3D technology under React Three Fiber.
reachFor: WebGL effects that flat animation cannot express
avoid: Using raw Three.js inside React presets — go through React Three Fiber (see react-three-fiber/)
3D for its own sake — principle §9: 3D supports the design, it does not become the design
reactWiring: inside React presets use @react-three/fiber; raw Three only for imperative canvases
